Title: Second Tradition and Daring the Dawn

Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
Can I play a Second Tradition to untap an on action I can't block?

Eg someone bleeds with Daring the Dawn and I want to deflect -can I
untap to do so with a 2nd and fail the obligatory attempt to block?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Timlagor wrote:
> Can I play a Second Tradition to untap an on action I can't block?

No. Card text on 2nd requires a block. You must be able to block.

> Eg someone bleeds with Daring the Dawn and I want to deflect -can I
> untap to do so with a 2nd and fail the obligatory attempt to block?

No.
